The '''39th Recon''' was an [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] ground assault unit that participated in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. [[Scout trooper/Legends|Scout troopers]] in the 39th Recon were equipped with [[74-Z speeder bike/Legends|74-Z speeder bikes]] that were used for reconnaissance purposes, as well as rapid transportation in combat zones. The unit was also outfitted with some [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST]] recon vehicles for hit-and-run tactics. When compared to the [[27th Elite Recon]], the speeder bike detachments were not as accurate in combat but their AT-ST units were stronger offensively.
